usage: 凍可樂 is used as a noun to refer to a chilled Coca-Cola drink.
It can be used as the object in a sentence, for example, '我想要一杯凍可樂' means 'I want a cup of iced Coke.'
The word 凍可樂 often appears in restaurant or cafe menus.
You can use it with measure words like 杯 (cup) or 支 (bottle), e.g., '兩杯凍可樂'.
凍可樂 can also be combined with adjectives like 甜 (sweet) or 冷 (cold) to describe the drink more vividly.
